description: TOG-CODE.md: the ToG code family. Generated by spec/tools/tog_vectors.py from the reference model spec/tools/tog_code.py; do not edit by hand. Errors: malformed (not a code), mistyped (the check fails), no_code (a record that gives no code). A PG- string is not a code anywhere; typed, it gets `message`, the one retired message, and no TOG suggestion. `migrate` is a registry's own migration of its own rows; `proxy` is pregen.org's lookup proxy shim. Times in `parties` are plain ordered numbers.
